name: Ring Mod
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A carrier ring-modulated by two independently detuned sines, driven through a saturating shaper.

controls.label: Detune 1
controls.description: Detunes the first modulator through harmonic and clangorous intervals.

controls.label: Detune 2
controls.description: Detunes the second modulator, thickening the sideband cluster.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Fades from a bare carrier to full three-way ring modulation.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Drives the output shaper, from clean multiplication to hard saturation.

outputs.aux: Carrier times the first modulator only.
